description: Organize Codex chat sessions into projects without changing their conversation context.
view.welcome:
No matching Codex tasks were found.
[Refresh](command:codexTaskOrganizer.refresh) or [create a project](command:codexTaskOrganizer.createProject).
configuration.title: Codex Task Organizer
configuration.providerFilter: Case-insensitive text used to match a chat session provider ID or label. Leave empty to show every provider.
configuration.showArchived: Show archived chat sessions in Codex Projects.
configuration.refreshInterval: Number of seconds between automatic session refreshes. Set to 0 to disable automatic refresh.
